channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: DEFCON
item.description: Inspired by the 1983 cult classic film, Wargames, DEFCON superbly evokes the tension, paranoia and suspicion of the Cold War era, playing on the fascinating aspects of psychological gameplay that occur during strategic nuclear warfare.

item.title: Dicevaders
item.description: Dicevaders is a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder about leading the ultimate alien invasion. Set in the StarVaders universe, draft and manipulate the dice row, build an unstoppable army, and unleash adrenaline pumping combos through powerful synergies and strategic play.

item.title: Endless Rails
item.description: Protect your train with your drones as it rolls through a monster-infested wasteland. Reach new stations to buy new weapons, wagons, and upgrades. Keep rolling until you or the game crashes. Isometric bullet heaven roguelite.

item.title: Needle In A Haystack
item.description: Find a needle hidden in over 10 million pieces of hay with up to 5 other friends.

item.title: Nivalis Nights
item.description: Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in a cyberpunk city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds.

item.title: Nivalis Nights Soundtrack
item.description: Immerse yourself in the sonic architecture of the cyberpunk metropolis with the Nivalis Nights Original Soundtrack, the definitive audio companion to your slice-of-life journey through the city of Nivalis.

item.title: Tempest Rising: The Veti’s Wrath
item.description: Take command of the fractured Veti to reclaim what is rightfully yours. Subjugate your foes and use them as tools to sacrifice for your goals in the conquest for vengeance against enemies both new and older than humanity itself.

item.title: TOEM 2
item.description: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

item.title: TOEM: A Photo Adventure
item.description: Set off on a delightful expedition and use your photographic eye to uncover the mysteries of the magical TOEM in this hand-drawn adventure game. Chat with quirky characters, solve their problems by snapping neat photos, and make your way through a relaxing landscape!

item.title: Greenhouse: Tidy Up!
item.description: Greenhouse: Tidy Up! is a cozy single-player simulation where you bring order to a messy greenhouse. Sort and place hundreds of flowers and plants, find the best way to organize everything, and compete with other players for the fastest time.

item.title: Island of Rebirth~NTR and Love~
item.description: A mysterious island suddenly appears at sea. Rick, a protagonist suffering from amnesia, encounters two beautiful girls, Sienna and Mila. The three embark on a journey of exploration across the island.

item.title: Frutiger Home
item.description: Decorate your dream frutiger home in this cozy co-op frutiger aero house decorating game. Pick a home layout, add from a wide range of frutiger-themed decor and hang out with your friends!

item.title: HR: Human Remains
item.description: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

item.title: Radiotext
item.description: Rise against the corporate overlords and become a cyber activist hacker. Join the uprising in a cyberpunk world using radio waves.

item.title: Ammossum
item.description: Build an endlessly upgradable weapon! Evolve projectiles into unstoppable firepower in this action roguelike. Fight through hordes of infected beasts, hunt down the source of the plague, and feel the thrill of bloody shootouts filled with bullets, explosions, and acid. Can you survive the madness?

item.title: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
item.description: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

item.title: Bug Cleaners
item.description: Ready to stop the bug infestation? Grab your wildest tools, go solo or team up with up to 4 players for chaotic missions, work together or totally troll the team! Bug cleaning has never been this fun and crazy!

item.title: Card Shop Simulator Multiplayer
item.description: Open a card shop with your friends, you can cooperate in a shop or compete with individual shops on the same street! Collect nice cards with different elements and play card dual with your friends to win their cards from their collection!

item.title: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow – Mirror of Fate HD
item.description: This sequel to Castlevania: Lords of Shadow reveals the story of the Belmonts as they battle destiny across generations to discover their true fate. Trevor Belmont, knight of the Brotherhood of Light, embarks on an epic quest to avenge his mother who was killed by his father Gabriel.

item.title: Drop Command
item.description: '90s Mech combat at a grand scale! Build an empire across the stars. Pilot Mechs, Tanks, Infantry and Aircraft in combined arms combat on many worlds across the star cluster. Rise to command entire battalions throughout a sandbox campaign.

item.title: Tales of Maj'Eyal
item.description: Tales of Maj’Eyal is a roguelike RPG, featuring tactical turn-based combat and advanced character building. Play as one of many unique races and classes in the lore-filled world of Eyal, exploring random dungeons, facing challenging battles, and developing characters with your own tailored mix of abilities and powers.

item.title: Explosive Odds - Supporter Pack
item.description: The Explosive Odds Supporter Pack provides a few extra costumes. If you like the game and you like us and you want to give us more money here's your chance! Comes with two Pig Bot hats and the test hat!
